localhostProfile.description: Name of the profile loaded on the node, with the `Localhost` type.

appArmorProfile.description: AppArmor profile of the containers of the pod.

fsGroup.description: Group ID owning the volumes of the pod, and the files created in them.

fsGroupChangePolicy.description: Whether the ownership of the volumes is changed on mount.

runAsGroup.description: Group ID of the first process of the containers of the pod.

runAsNonRoot.description: Whether the containers of the pod must run as a non-root user.

runAsUser.description: User ID of the first process of the containers of the pod.

seLinuxChangePolicy.description: How the SELinux labels of the volumes are changed.

seLinuxOptions.description: SELinux options of the containers of the pod.

localhostProfile.description: Path of the profile on the node, relative to the kubelet seccomp directory, with the `Localhost` type.

seccompProfile.description: Seccomp profile of the containers of the pod.

supplementalGroups.description: Additional group IDs of the containers of the pod.

supplementalGroupsPolicy.description: How the supplemental groups are computed, with the groups of the image.

sysctls.description: Namespaced sysctls set for the pod.

gmsaCredentialSpec.description: Contents of the GMSA credential spec, Windows only.

gmsaCredentialSpecName.description: Name of the GMSA credential spec, Windows only.

hostProcess.description: Whether the containers run as HostProcess containers, Windows only.

runAsUserName.description: User name the first process of the containers runs as, Windows only.

windowsOptions.description: Windows specific options of the pod.
